hypotheses.claim: A real zero-broadcast state plus explicit selected article IDs reduces distracting context and improves source-bound answer accuracy compared with unconditional top-three injection.
hypotheses.falsifier: On held-out exact-source questions, Gen190 fails to improve answer correctness and unsupported-claim rate at matched context size, or gains come only from lexical-copy questions used during tuning.

hypotheses.claim: The hard relevance>0 gate discards semantically correct paraphrase/associative evidence precisely when deeper retrieval adds value, reversing the benefit of paket/graph retrieval.
hypotheses.falsifier: A held-out paraphrase set with human-labeled gold evidence shows zero or negligible additional false rejection versus a semantic/evidential comparator while preserving distractor rejection.

hypotheses.claim: The novelty term prevents repetitive evidence monopolies and increases useful evidence diversity across turns.
hypotheses.falsifier: Diversity rises without answer-level gain, or repeated valid facts fall below the threshold and cause omissions/refusals.

hypotheses.claim: Because the last-50 broadcast counts are not conditioned on user, session, query or claim, one user's prior use can suppress the other user's still-correct evidence; repeated truth is taxed as if it were stale.
hypotheses.falsifier: Paired Gabriel/Andreas and repeated-question tests show invariant admission of still-relevant gold evidence, or history is proven to be appropriately scoped before scoring.

hypotheses.claim: The 0.35 s IDF budget is a Timeout Mirage at SQL-query granularity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fault-injected long FTS queries are interrupted within the bound with a receipt showing progress-handler/interrupt behavior and clean fallback.

new_concepts.name: Lexical Gate Reversal
new_concepts.definition: A downstream lexical-overlap gate removes semantic evidence recovered by a more capable upstream retriever.

new_concepts.name: Global Novelty Tax
new_concepts.definition: Evidence is penalized by broadcasts from unrelated users, sessions or questions because novelty history lacks causal scope.

new_concepts.name: Repeated-Truth Starvation
new_concepts.definition: A stable correct fact becomes progressively less admissible merely because it has been used successfully before.

new_concepts.name: Broadcast Causal Aperture
new_concepts.definition: The measurable set difference between retrieved candidates, mechanically admitted candidates, model-selected IDs and text actually shown to Zero.

new_concepts.name: In-query Deadline
new_concepts.definition: A time budget enforced inside the database operation, not only between calls.

Run IDF_IN_QUERY_DEADLINE_RECEIPT/v1 with a deliberately expensive FTS COUNT. Require bounded wall time, progress-handler or interrupt receipt, handler cleanup, unchanged connection usability and explicit unweighted fallback.

Represent candidate->admitted->selected->broadcast->cited as distinct provenance edges. Attach novelty scope and threshold version; do not increase truth confidence merely because an item won competition.
